main_body: East-facing pew with wooden backrest on the left and three red seat cushions on the right
top_band: Light brown wood and three red cushion top surfaces (rows 13-57), stepping down at row 58 into the south-facing side apron/end panel
evidence: The pew runs north-south facing east: the backrest top (rows 8-56) and the horizontal seat surface with three red cushions (rows 13-57) are seen from above, followed by a light front edge highlight at row 58 and a 5-row vertical south end face (rows 58-62).

style.evidence: Each red cushion is a large ~6x10 pixel block of a single flat red with only a 1px dark red border on two sides, and the backrest is long uninterrupted vertical strips of 2 flat browns with no wood grain or tonal variation, looking much flatter than the textured Beodeul references.
